app_metadata.description: Discovers IPMI/SMART sensors on a Dell PowerEdge server and drives fan speed via a smoothed, curve-based control loop, with an automatic safety fallback back to the iDRAC's own automatic control.

host_mounts.description: Full host device access (read-write) - needed to send raw IPMI fan control commands to /dev/ipmi0 and to read SMART data for disks behind a hardware RAID/HBA controller.
Read-only access to udev device metadata, used by smartctl to enumerate disks. (Read Only)

run_as_context.description: Container [dellfanctl] runs as root user and group (needed for raw IPMI/SMART hardware access).
